pages.text:
Hops are perennial: plant them once and pick them again and again.
- Stand a Trellis on farmland or Loam Farmland. A second one can go on top.
- Use Hop Seeds on the bottom Trellis. The vine grows up it and, once full, climbs into the Trellis above.
- A vine bearing cones shows them. Use it to pick 1 to 3 Hop Cones; the vine stays and bears again.
- Wild hops grow in forests and taigas, and hop seeds turn up in grass.
